note: Per-image classification inside image_process (resale_listing_ai/adapters.py's _classify_image()). IMAGE_CATEGORIES is derived from json_schema.properties.category.enum at load time -- one authority, nothing to drift out of sync.
instructions: Classify this single product-intake photo. category: 'actual_product' if it shows the physical unit itself, 'original_packaging' if it primarily shows the retail box/packaging, 'product_information_label' if it primarily shows a rating plate/label/barcode sticker, otherwise 'contextual'. needs_cleanup: true ONLY if a measuring tape, ruler, or other extraneous clutter unrelated to the product is visible in frame and should be removed. If true, clutter_bbox must be a tight bounding box (x, y, w, h, each a fraction 0-1 of image width/height) around ONLY that clutter — never around the product itself, and never covering areas that show the product's true condition (scuffs, cracks, wear). If you are not confident of a tight box, set needs_cleanup to false and clutter_bbox to null rather than guessing.
